page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d3s.12xlarge is an instance type belonging to the Big data server family, built for data-intensive storage workloads. It operates on the x86_64 architecture using dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processors clocked at 2.7 GHz across 48 vCPUs. The compute setup is paired with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a consistent ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

A defining characteristic of this configuration is its massive storage capacity, featuring 286044 GB of bundled local HDD storage. Network throughput is scaled for high-volume data ingest and movement, featuring a 60 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance does not include integrated GPUs and operates under the KVM hypervisor without complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the integration of large-scale mechanical hard drives makes this hardware configuration economical for high-density sequential data storage compared to solid-state alternatives. The tradeoff lies in the storage medium itself, as hard disk drives offer lower random I/O performance and higher latency than NVMe SSDs, while prioritizing bulk capacity. Consequently, the instance is targeted at big data processing, distributed storage clusters, Hadoop/Spark workloads, data archiving, and large-scale log analytics.
